subject: Marketplace SKU thresholds & co-sell trigger policy
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, AWS Marketplace PM <aws-marketplace-pm@amazon.com>
Date: 2026-11-05T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Marketplace SKU thresholds & co-sell trigger policy

Team —

Opening a short thread to align on how we gate SKUs across AWS/Azure/GCP and the conditions that will auto-trigger a co-sell engagement. Acme AI will be our first pilot for a multi-region listing and they want clarity on:

- Minimum committed ARR / monthly spend that qualifies a SKU for co-sell
- Regional availability requirements (US/EU first, then APAC)
- Packaging constraints (single SKU vs bundle) that marketplaces accept

Attached: sku_matrix_v3.xlsx (working assumptions).

Questions I have:
1) Is there a single threshold we can use across clouds, or do we need cloud-specific gates?
2) Can we rely on marketplace incentives to drive initial adoption, or should Redwood front incentives for pilot accounts?

Can Karthik and Camila propose recommended thresholds by EOD Tuesday? I can loop in AWS/Azure partners for acceptance criteria after we pick numbers.

Thanks,
Jordan Blake
Head of GTM Strategy | Redwood Inference
jordan_blake@redwood.ai

--
Attachments: sku_matrix_v3.xlsx (spreadsheet - 120KB)
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>, Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-05T14:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Marketplace SKU thresholds & co-sell trigger policy

Jordan —

Quick thoughts from the cloud-ops/pricing side after reviewing sku_matrix_v3:

- Cloud-specific gates: recommend cloud-specific thresholds. Azure co-sell requires partner lead generation and a minimal technical validation (P0 latency SLA) before they’ll engage. AWS is more volume-driven and accepts lower initial ARR but expects a streamlined procurement listing. GCP is stricter on data residency for EU customers.

- Proposed minimums for pilot (Acme AI):
  - AWS: $12k TCV over 3 months OR 20k tokens/month sustained
  - Azure: $20k TCV over 3 months + completed technical validation (perf run)
  - GCP: $25k TCV over 3 months + EU-only SKUs require data residency attestation

- Packaging: for marketplaces we should list a single entry SKU for the core inference service and a separate "enterprise add-on" SKU for dedicated/private deployment. Bundles complicate co-sell rebates.

I'll attach a brief where I map each cloud's acceptance criteria — see sku_matrix_v3.xlsx. Happy to iterate.

— Karthik
Sr. Product Manager, Marketplace & Partnerships
karthik_iyer@redwood.ai

Date: 2026-11-06T10:22:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Marketplace SKU thresholds & co-sell trigger policy

Hi Jordan / team —

Thanks for the summary and the spreadsheet. A few notes from the AWS side:

- We typically approve co-sell when the partner demonstrates repeatable demand and at least one reference deployment. For pilots we can be flexible on pure ARR, but we need a technical verification (security + deployment guide) and the listing to conform to our metering model.

- The $12k over 3 months is reasonable for a trial path. If Redwood can provide a usage-based metering endpoint (tokens) and a short billing reconciliation doc, we can enable co-sell nomination earlier.

- Doc links: we require a marketplace listing doc + security questionnaire (send SOC2 summary). We can accept a pro forma agreement for the first 90 days.

Happy to schedule a 30-min sync with our partner strategy lead to walk through nomination steps.

Regards,
Samir Patel
AWS Marketplace PM
aws-marketplace-pm@amazon.com

--
From: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.ai>

Subject: Re: Marketplace SKU thresholds & co-sell trigger policy

Thanks Samir and team —

I captured the decisions so far and proposed an actionable checklist. See attached sku_matrix_v4.xlsx and a short co-sell_playbook_v1.pdf stub. Key takeaways:

- Pilot thresholds (finalized): AWS $12k TCV / 3 months; Azure $20k + technical validation; GCP $25k + data residency attestation.
- Packaging: publish one core SKU per cloud, plus an "enterprise" add-on SKU for Dedicated/Private.
- Required artifacts before nomination: marketplace listing page, SOC2 summary, simple deployment runbook, and at least one customer reference or internal pilot report.

Action items:
- Karthik: finalize the metering model and produce the billing reconciliation doc (due 11/10).
- Marcus: update RD marketplace backlog to add the three SKU entries and tag EU residency for GCP (due 11/12).
- Jordan: coordinate nomination with AWS / Azure partners and confirm timing with Acme AI (due 11/09).

I'll also prep the HubSpot deal record and attach the playbook.

Camila Reyes
Partner GTM Lead | Redwood Inference
